instruction: I need to change my Chrome profile username to Jennifer. Could you update the profile name to Jennifer?

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing Chrome profile name to 'Jennifer'. Uses existing get_profile_name getter and exact_match metric. Same complexity as original task.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly extracts Chrome profile name from Preferences file using appropriate JSON path (profile.name)
Metric (exact_match) correctly performs exact string comparison suitable for profile names
Expected value 'Jennifer' semantically matches the instruction requirement
Postconfig appropriately restarts Chrome to ensure configuration changes are persisted to disk and readable by getter
Complete coverage: evaluator checks the single requirement in the instruction (profile name change to Jennifer)

Runtime feasibility confirmed: getter can access Preferences file, metric can compare strings, expected value is accurate
